nodes.name: Fetch Instantly Replies
nodes.notes: Pulls recent received emails from Instantly's Unibox. Adjust endpoint if Instantly's API changes.

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "model": "claude-haiku-4-5-20251001",
  "max_tokens": 200,
  "system": "Classify this email reply into exactly ONE category. Reply with ONLY the category name, nothing else.

Categories:
- positive_reply (interested, asks questions, wants to learn more, warm tone)
- booked (explicitly agrees to a call/meeting, provides times, confirms)
- not_interested (explicitly declines, says no thanks, not a fit)
- unsubscribe (asks to be removed, stop emailing, opt out)
- out_of_office (auto-reply, vacation, OOO)
- neutral (unclear intent, vague response, neither positive nor negative)",
  "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": {{ JSON.stringify('Reply from ' + $json.business_name + ':

' + $json.reply_body) }}}]
}

nodes.name: Claude: Classify Reply
nodes.notes: Uses Haiku for classification — fast and cheap. Only needs one word output.
